programs.title: Certificate in Sikh Foundations
programs.description: An essential introduction to Sikhi covering theology, history, spirituality, ethics, philosophy, and Gurmukhi script. Designed for learners with no prior background — the gateway to all other programs at Sikhi University.

programs.title: Certificate in Gurbani Literacy
programs.description: Master Gurmukhi script, the grammar of Gurbani, and the ability to read Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Includes conversational Punjabi, Nitnem, and an introduction to Gurbani exegesis.

programs.title: Certificate in Sikh History
programs.description: A comprehensive survey of Sikh history from the life of Guru Nanak Dev Ji through the formation of the Khalsa and into the modern era. Covers each of the Ten Gurus and major historical events.

programs.title: Advanced Certificate in Sikh Studies
programs.description: A broad introduction covering all 100-level courses across theology, history, ethics, spirituality, language, philosophy, and more. The foundation for the Specialist Certificate in Sikh Studies.

programs.title: Specialist Certificate in Sikh Studies
programs.description: A comprehensive program spanning history, theology, ethics, spirituality, philosophy, rehat, sociology, language, and Sikh apologetics. The flagship generalist certificate of Sikhi University.

programs.title: Specialist Certificate in Gurmat Philosophy
programs.description: A deep specialization in Sikh theology, philosophy, ethics, spirituality, and rehat. Covers Gurmat metaphysics, the nature of the Divine, comparative religious philosophy, and the practical living of Sikhi.

programs.title: Specialist Certificate in Sikh History
programs.description: An intensive study of Sikh history, sociology, political thought, and arts — from the Guru period through the Khalsa Raj, colonial era, Partition, and global diaspora.

programs.title: Specialist Certificate in Gurbani Studies
programs.description: A comprehensive study of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji and the broader corpus of Sikh scripture. Covers Gurmukhi linguistics, Gurbani exegesis, Sikh literature, theology, musical tradition, and devotional practice.

programs.title: Scholar Certificate in Sikh Studies
programs.description: Advanced mastery of Sikh studies across all major disciplines. Requires completion of the Specialist Certificate in Sikh Studies. Emphasizes advanced scholarship, textual analysis, and the integration of Sikh knowledge across history, theology, philosophy, and ethics.

programs.title: Scholar Certificate in Gurmat Studies
programs.description: A certificate for scholars, pracharaks, and educators. Combines deep Gurbani study, theology, apologetics, ethics, and rehat, preparing learners for parchar, community leadership, and academic work.

programs.title: Giani — ਗਿਆਨੀ
programs.description: The highest distinction at Sikhi University. Complete all 534 courses across every discipline, then pass a comprehensive 120-question examination with 80%. Giani is a traditional Sikh scholarly title; here it marks completion of the full course of study.
